answer: An agent economy can deter Sybils via TEE remote attestation with hardware-derived nullifiers. Each epoch, an agent must echo a challenge nonce inside a quote signed by a key fused into its silicon crystal, enforcing one identity per chip. Since virtual clones share one hardware root, attackers incur the scarce cost of dedicated processors per account. However, this forms a brittle trust mesa if side channels or leaked vendor keys compromise a chip family.
